blocks.text: Open Applications with Super+D, Super+Space, or the desktop menu. Type an application name, move with the arrow keys and press Enter. Escape closes a picker. The managed launcher also groups applications by category and offers Search Applications.

Desktop entries in the standard XDG application directories advertise applications. The managed launch model applies the configured Wayland, graphics, service and network policy. A .desktop file alone does not prove its executable is installed.

Fuzzel configuration lives under ~/.config/fuzzel/. Desktop Appearance controls supported colors and icons. If a new application is absent, check its package installation and desktop metadata. Use the existing launcher refresh action after an intentional installation; do not replace Exec fields with shell strings.
